div.div: بُسْرَةٌ مُوَكِّتَةٌ , and مُوَكِّتٌ, (the latter on the authority of Seer, TA) A date speckled, or becoming speckled, by reason of its ripening. (T, M, K.) When it is speckled in the part next the stalk, it is called مُذَنِّبَةٌ (TA.) See بُسْرٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
